title: A very cost efficient way to see the sights. Narration was useful
text: There is a lot of construction going on in Barcelona and also this weekend we were there right before Halloween.  This meant that some of the stops were unavailable and they did announce it but if you plan on the stops, you’d have to take a different route to get off and see some of the sites. The two routes are all you’d ever need to have to see everything worth seeing in Barcelona proper if you get there at 9 o’clock in Pl  de Catalunya you have the best shot for getting a seat. title: Good introduction to Barcelona
text: Good experience.  Seats on the top deck.  Plenty of earphones.
author: carolmR8139TS

title: Barcelona
text: Good way to see overview of Barcelona, however, a few of the stops, one in particular, feels like being left in a wasteland.
author: Phillip_H

title: Beautiful city
text:
Excellent route taking in vast areas of the city (it took well over 2.5 hours on one route). The stops to get on/off seemed to be well thought out.
Unfortunately didn’t get to see a Gaudi house, as bus doesn’t go past so just caught a glimpse.
Vast amount of information given via the audio guide.
Also seems you can get entrance tickets to some attractions whist on board.
Highly recommend.
author: lindasV1618WY

title: Always great!
text: Awesome way to get around the city and get the lay of the land.  Always a great choice when visiting big cities.  Highly recommend.
author: DebbieM1955

title: Initially difficult to...
text: Initially difficult to find the stop near our hotel: maybe brochure /map could be available at hotel since the staff had no idea where we were to go. The info on app hard to access as well but once we got on bus the tour was very good and comfortable
author: Deb_B

title: Barcelona tour
text: Ideal for discovering the city, there are two different circuits so we did the main points of interest. For two days it was great.
author: Compass51434725787

title: Good way to see the city!
text: Hits numerous points of interest.  Great way to see the city if you don’t have a great deal of time. On time, you don’t have to wait too long for the next bus.
author: Dan_R

title: On Time and friendly...
text: On Time and friendly guides who tried to help as much as they could with information on sights. Drivers were excellent and this was a great budget friendly way to see most of the sights.
author: Gilbert_P

title: The experience was great....
text: The experience was great. I would highly recommend this to everyone. there were plenty of stops. and plenty of busses.
author: ROBERT_G
